grammar: Do + you + have + this + in + size?
en: Do you have this in a larger size?
tr: Bunu daha büyük bedende var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ðɪs ɪn ə ˈlɑrʤər saɪz/
trPron: Du yu hev dis in ı larcır sayz
collocations: do you have, in a larger
commonMistake: Do you have this a larger size? ❌
aiExplain: In a larger size kalıbında "in" şarttır.

grammar: Does + this + have + noun + in it?
en: Does this dish have garlic in it?
tr: Bu yemeğin içinde sarımsak var mı?
ipa: /dʌz ðɪs dɪʃ hæv ˈgɑrlɪk ɪn ɪt/
trPron: Daz dis diş hev garlik in it
collocations: does this have, have garlic
commonMistake: Does this dish have garlic? ❌ (anlam farklı)
aiExplain: In it yemeğin içinde anlamını vurgular.

grammar: I + have + a/an + symptom
en: I have a sore throat and a runny nose.
tr: Boğaz ağrım ve akan burnum var.
ipa: /aɪ hæv ə sɔr θroʊt ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
trPron: Ay hev ı sor tırot end ı rani noz
collocations: have a sore, have a runny
commonMistake: I have sore throat. ❌
aiExplain: Sore throat sayılabilir bir isim olarak "a" alır.

grammar: Subject + have to + verb (obligation)
en: You have to finish this by Friday.
tr: Bunu Cuma'ya kadar bitirmek zorundasın.
ipa: /juː hæv tu ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
trPron: Yu hev tu fİnİş dis bay fraydey
collocations: have to finish, finish by
commonMistake: You have finish this by Friday. ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + a + reservation?
en: Do you have a reservation under the name Smith?
tr: Smith adına bir rezervasyonunuz var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ə ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən ˈʌndər ðə neɪm smɪθ/
trPron: Du yu hev ı rezörveyşın andır dı neym Smith
collocations: do you have, have a reservation
commonMistake: Do you have reservation? ❌

grammar: You + don't have to + verb (no obligation)
en: You don't have to eat everything on your plate.
tr: Tabaktaki her şeyi yemek zorunda değilsin.
ipa: /juː doʊnt hæv tu it ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɑn jʊr pleɪt/
trPron: Yu dont hev tu it evriİng on yur pleyt
collocations: don't have to, have to eat
commonMistake: You mustn't eat everything. ❌ (farklı anlam)
aiExplain: Don't have to zorunluluk olmadığını, "mustn't" yasak olduğunu belirtir.
imgQuery: mother talking to child at table

grammar: Do + you + have + this + in stock?
en: Do you have this in stock?
tr: Bundan stokta var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ðɪs ɪn stɑk/
trPron: Du yu hev dis in stak
collocations: do you have, in stock
commonMistake: Do you have this stock? ❌

grammar: Can + I + have + noun? (request)
en: can I have, have a day off
tr: day, days, daily
ipa: holiday, break
trPron: workday, none
commonMistake: A1

grammar: I'll + have + noun (future order)
en: I'll have the steak, please.
tr: Biftek alacağım, lütfen.
ipa: /aɪl hæv ðə steɪk pliz/
trPron: Ayl hev dı steyk pliz
collocations: I'll have, have the steak
commonMistake: I want the steak. ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: I'll have restoranlarda sipariş vermek için kibar bir ifadedir.

grammar: Can + I + have + a + noun? (polite request)
en: Can I have a glass of water?
tr: Bir bardak su alabilir miyim?
ipa: /kæn aɪ hæv ə glæs əv ˈwɔtər/
trPron: Ken ay hev ı glas ov vatır
collocations: can I have, have a glass
commonMistake: Can I have glass of water? ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + anything + to declare?
en: Do you have anything to declare?
tr: Beyan edecek bir şeyiniz var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈɛniθɪŋ tu dɪˈklɛr/
trPron: Du yu hev eniİng tu dikler
collocations: do you have, have to declare
commonMistake: Do you have anything declare? ❌

grammar: I + don't have + the + noun + to + verb
en: I don't have the password to access the file.
tr: Dosyaya erişmek için şifrem yok.
ipa: /aɪ doʊnt hæv ðə ˈpæswɜrd tu ˈæksɛs ðə faɪl/
trPron: Ay dont hev dı password tu akses dı fayl
collocations: don't have the, have to access
commonMistake: I don't have the password access the file. ❌
imgQuery: person staring at computer lock screen

grammar: Do + you + happen + to have + noun?
en: Do you happen to have a pen I could borrow?
tr: Ödünç alabileceğim bir kalemin var mı?
ipa: /duː juː ˈhæpən tu hæv ə pɛn aɪ kʊd ˈbɑroʊ/
trPron: Du yu hepın tu hev ı pen ay kud baro
collocations: do you happen to, happen to have
commonMistake: Do you happen have a pen? ❌

grammar: You + have got to + verb (strong obligation)
en: You have got to clean your room today.
tr: Bugün odanı temizlemek zorundasın.
ipa: /juː hæv gɑt tu klin jʊr rum təˈdeɪ/
trPron: Yu hev gat tu klin yur rum tudey
collocations: have got to, got to clean
commonMistake: You have to clean your room. ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: Have got to "have to" ile aynı anlamdadır ama daha samimi/vurguludur.

grammar: Do + you + have + something + for + symptom?
en: Do you have something for a headache?
tr: Baş ağrısı için bir şeyiniz var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔr ə ˈhɛdeɪk/
trPron: Du yu hev samtİng for ı hedeyk
collocations: do you have, have for a
commonMistake: Do you have something for headache? ❌
aiExplain: Headache sayılabilir isim olduğu için "a" alır.

grammar: Do + you + have + access + to + noun?
en: Do you have access to the company database?
tr: Şirket veritabanına erişimin var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈæksɛs tu ðə ˈkʌmpəni ˈdeɪtəbeɪs/
trPron: Du yu hev akses tu dı kampını deytabeyz
collocations: have access to, access to
commonMistake: Do you have access the company database? ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + any + tours + to + place?
en: Do you have any tours to Pamukkale?
tr: Pamukkale'ye turlarınız var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni tʊrz tu pɑˈmʊkɑlɛ/
trPron: Du yu hev eni turs tu Pamukkale
collocations: do you have, tours to
commonMistake: Do you have any tours Pamukkale? ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + a + table + for + number?
en: Do you have a table for four?
tr: Dört kişilik bir masanız var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ə ˈteɪbəl fɔr fɔr/
trPron: Du yu hev ı teybıl for for
collocations: do you have, have a table
commonMistake: Do you have table for four? ❌

grammar: Do + we + have + any + other + business?
en: Do we have any other business to discuss?
tr: Tartışacağımız başka bir konu var mı?
ipa: /duː wi hæv ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈbɪznəs tu dɪˈskʌs/
trPron: Du vi hev eni azır biznıs tu diskas
collocations: do we have, have to discuss
commonMistake: Do we have any other business discuss? ❌

grammar: Can + I + have + a + receipt?
en: Can I have a receipt, please?
tr: Fiş alabilir miyim, lütfen?
ipa: /kæn aɪ hæv ə rɪˈsit pliz/
trPron: Ken ay hev ı risit pliz
collocations: can I have, have a receipt
commonMistake: Can I have receipt? ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + a + driver's + license?
en: Do you have a valid driver's license?
tr: Geçerli bir ehliyetiniz var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ə ˈvælɪd ˈdraɪvərz ˈlaɪsəns/
trPron: Du yu hev ı valid drayvırz laysıns
collocations: do you have, have a license
commonMistake: Do you have valid driver's license? ❌

grammar: Do + you + have + a + moment?
en: Do you have a moment to talk?
tr: Konuşmak için bir dakikan var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ə ˈmoʊmənt tu tɔk/
trPron: Du yu hev ı momınt tu tok
collocations: do you have, have a moment
commonMistake: Do you have moment to talk? ❌

grammar: Do + we + have + enough + noun?
en: Do we have enough budget for this?
tr: Bunun için yeterli bütçemiz var mı?
ipa: /duː wi hæv ɪˈnʌf ˈbʌʤɪt fɔr ðɪs/
trPron: Du vi hev inaf bacit for dis
collocations: do we have, have enough
commonMistake: We have enough budget for this? ❌
aiExplain: We have enough budget? soru işareti olsa bile yanlıştır.

grammar: Does + this + have + noun + in + it?
en: Does this soup have nuts in it?
tr: Bu çorbanın içinde kuruyemiş var mı?
ipa: /dʌz ðɪs sup hæv nʌts ɪn ɪt/
trPron: Daz dis sup hev nats in it
collocations: does this have, have in it
commonMistake: Does this soup have nuts? ❌ (anlam farklı)
aiExplain: In it yemeğin içinde anlamını vurgular.
imgQuery: person looking at menu with allergy

grammar: I + have + to + go + now
en: I have to go now. It was nice talking to you.
tr: Şimdi gitmem gerek. Seninle konuşmak güzeldi.
ipa: /aɪ hæv tu goʊ naʊ ɪt wʌz naɪs ˈtɔkɪŋ tu ju/
trPron: Ay hev tu go nau it vaz nays tokİng tu yu
collocations: have to go, go now
commonMistake: I have go now. ❌
